ultimates.name: Nano Boost
ultimates.description: Increases an ally's damage, while reducing damage taken.

ultimates.name: Vermillion Ascent
ultimates.description: Charge forward, exploding on impact and instantly igniting enemies.

ultimates.name: B.O.B.
ultimates.description: Deploy Bob. He charges forward and knocks enemies into the air, then attacks with his arm cannons.

ultimates.name: Amplification Matrix
ultimates.description: Project a matrix that doubles the damage and healing of allied projectiles.

ultimates.name: Configuration: Artillery
ultimates.description: Become immobile and fire up to three powerful artillery shells.

ultimates.name: Rally
ultimates.description: Gain armor, empower Barrier Shield and provide extra health to nearby allies.

ultimates.name: Deadeye
ultimates.detail: 150 per second (during warning) / 300 per second (remaining duration)
ultimates.description: Face off against your enemies. Press {{key|ultimate}} to lock on, then {{key|ultimate}} or {{key|primary fire}} to fire.

ultimates.name: Panopticon
ultimates.description: Fire a hard-light barrier that imprisons enemies and detonates on expiration.

ultimates.name: Meteor Strike
ultimates.description: Press {{key|ultimate}} to leap up into the air. Move the targeting circle, then press {{key|primary fire}} to strike the targeted area.

ultimates.name: Self-Destruct
ultimates.description: Eject and overload your mech, causing it to explode after a short time.

ultimates.name: Duplicate
ultimates.description: Become a copy of the targeted hero. They cannot swap heroes for the duration.

ultimates.name: Override Protocol
ultimates.detail: 45 (light round direct hit) / 30 - 9 (light round area of effect) / 175 (heavy round direct hit) / 140 - 70 (heavy round area of effect)
ultimates.description: An override initiates, transforming you into a living weapon.

ultimates.name: Bola Shot
ultimates.description: Fire an explosive bola. Hitting an enemy wraps them up and pulls in other nearby enemies.

ultimates.name: Dragonblade
ultimates.description: Unsheathe a deadly melee weapon.

ultimates.name: Dragonstrike
ultimates.description: Launch a deadly Dragon Spirit that devastates enemies it passes through.

ultimates.name: Downpour
ultimates.description: Rain down a torrent of spikes, Immobilizing enemies.

ultimates.name: Captive Sun
ultimates.description: Fire an explosive ball of solar energy. Enemies hit are slowed and explode after taking significant damage.

ultimates.name: Catnapper
ultimates.description: Dive towards a ground location, knocking down enemies and tethering the nearest one to you.

ultimates.name: Rampage
ultimates.description: Charge foward. Wounds enemies, dealing damage over time and preventing them from being healed.

ultimates.name: RIP-Tire
ultimates.description: Drive and detonate an exploding tire.

ultimates.name: Orbital Ray
ultimates.description: Call down a ray that travels forward, healing allies and increasing their damage.

ultimates.name: Kitsune Rush
ultimates.description: Summon a fox spirit that rushes forward, accelerating the movement, attack speed, and cooldowns of allies that follow its path.

ultimates.name: Tree of Life
ultimates.description: Place a tree that instantly heals allies upon sprouting and continues healing periodically as it lives.

ultimates.name: Sound Barrier
ultimates.description: Create temporary extra health for nearby allies.

ultimates.name: Cage Fight
ultimates.description: Deploy a barrier that traps yourself and enemies. Automatically reloads Mauga's Chainguns at the start of the ultimate.

ultimates.name: Blizzard
ultimates.description: Launch a weather control drone that freezes enemies in a wide area.

ultimates.name: Valkyrie
ultimates.description: Gain the ability to fly. Abilities are enhanced.

ultimates.name: Kekkai Sanctuary
ultimates.description: Create a sanctuary that heals allies within and absorbs enemy projectiles that pass through it.

ultimates.name: Coalescence
ultimates.description: Fire a beam that heals allies and damages enemies.

ultimates.name: Terra Surge
ultimates.description: Sweep in enemies and anchor down, gaining the effects of Fortify and charging up a surge of damage. Use Primary Fire to unleash the surge early.

ultimates.name: Barrage
ultimates.description: Hover in place and launch a continuous volley of mini-rockets.

ultimates.name: Annihilation
ultimates.description: Enter Nemesis Form and create a deadly swarm that lashes out at nearby enemies, persisting longer when damaging enemies.

ultimates.name: Death Blossom
ultimates.description: Damage all nearby enemies.

ultimates.name: Earthshatter
ultimates.description: Knock down all enemies in front of you.

ultimates.name: Whole Hog
ultimates.description: Damage and knock back enemies in front of you.

ultimates.name: Satsuriku Spree
ultimates.description: Rush forward 3 times in a storm of gunfire.

ultimates.name: Trailblazer
ultimates.description: Deploy a drone that flies forward and drops explosives.

ultimates.name: Gravitic Flux
ultimates.description: Manipulate gravity to lift enemies into the air and slam them back down.

ultimates.name: Overclock
ultimates.description: Railgun energy auto-charges for a short duration.

ultimates.name: Tactical Visor
ultimates.description: Automatically aims your weapon at targets in view.

ultimates.name: EMP
ultimates.description: Deal damage to all nearby enemies based on their current health, hacking them and destroying barriers around you.

ultimates.name: Photon Barrier
ultimates.description: Deploy a massive energy barrier.

ultimates.name: Molten Core
ultimates.detail: 25 (impact) / 190 per second (pools, base) / +100 (pools, bonus against armor)
ultimates.description: Create pools of molten slag that damage enemies. Deals additional damage to armor.

ultimates.name: Pulse Bomb
ultimates.description: Throw out a powerful sticky explosive.

ultimates.name: Sundering Blade
ultimates.description: Cleave through most defenses, dealing severe damage to enemies in front of you.

ultimates.name: Tectonic Shock
ultimates.description: Send out damaging shockwaves.

ultimates.name: Infra-Sight
ultimates.description: Provide your team with a view of the enemy's location.

ultimates.name: Primal Rage
ultimates.description: Gain immense health, but you can only leap and punch enemies.

ultimates.name: Minefield
ultimates.description: Deploy a massive field of proximity mines.

ultimates.name: Tidal Blast
ultimates.description: Protect an ally or yourself with water that detonates after a short duration. The explosion knocks down enemies and massively heals the host target.

ultimates.name: Graviton Surge
ultimates.description: Launch a gravity well that pulls enemies to it.

ultimates.name: Transcendence
ultimates.description: Become invulnerable, move faster, and heal nearby allies.

healing.name: Healing Blossom
healing.detail: 90 over 0.3 seconds (max charge) / 10 over 0.3 seconds (min charge)

healing.name: Restorative Stream
healing.detail: 20 per second (passive) / 55 per second (bonus manual healing)

stadiumItems.name: Frenzy Amplifier
stadiumItems.description: Eliminations grant 10% Attack Speed and 15% Move Speed for 3s.

stadiumItems.name: Stratosphere Beacon
stadiumItems.description: Damage to airborne targets above 3m deals 10 bonus damage and slows the enemy by 25% for 3s (15s Cooldown)

stadiumItems.name: Advanced Nanobiotics
stadiumItems.description: After healing an ally, gain 10% Attack Speed for 3s.

stadiumItems.name: Emergency Chip
stadiumItems.description: Once per life, when you are below 150 Life, gain 15% Weapon Lifesteal and 50 Overhealth for 5s

stadiumItems.name: Shieldbuster
stadiumItems.description: After dealing damage to Shields or Armor, gain 15% Attack Speed for 1s.

stadiumItems.name: Aerial Distresser
stadiumItems.description: Weapon damage to airborne enemies deal 30% bonus damage over 3s.

stadiumItems.name: Salvaged Slugs
stadiumItems.description: Dealing Weapon Damage to Barriers or Deployables has a 60% chance to restore 1 ammo. If ammo cannot be restored, instead restore Life equal to 20% of damage dealt.

stadiumItems.name: Volskaya Ordnance
stadiumItems.description: Deal 6% increase Weapon Damage for every 100 Bonus Max Life the target has, up to 30%.

stadiumItems.name: Codebreaker
stadiumItems.description: Ignore 50% of Armor's damage reduction.

stadiumItems.name: Commander's Clip
stadiumItems.description: When you use an ability or Gadget, restore 10% of your Max Ammo.

stadiumItems.name: Weapon Jammer
stadiumItems.description: Dealing Weapon Damage negates 10% of the target's bonus Attack Speed and increases your Attack Speed by 10% for 2s.

stadiumItems.name: Amari's Antidote
stadiumItems.description: While healing an ally below 50% Life with your weapon, deal 15% increased Weapon Healing.

stadiumItems.name: Booster Jets
stadiumItems.description: When you use an ability or Gadget, gain 10% Move Speed for 2s.

stadiumItems.name: El-Sa'ka Suppressor
stadiumItems.description: Critical Hits apply 35% Healing Reduction to the target for 2s.

stadiumItems.name: Hardlight Accelerator
stadiumItems.description: When you use an ability or Gadget, gain 5% Weapon Power for 3s, stacking up to 3 times.

stadiumItems.name: The Closer
stadiumItems.description: Deal 10% increased damage to enemies below 30% Life.

stadiumItems.name: Eye of the Spider
stadiumItems.description: Critical Hits reveal the target for 3s.

stadiumItems.name: Charged Plating
stadiumItems.description: After you spend your Ultimate Charge, gain 25 Armor and 10% Ability Power for the rest of the round.

stadiumItems.name: Winning Attitude
stadiumItems.description: When you die, gain 15% Ultimate Charge.

stadiumItems.name: Biolight Overflow
stadiumItems.description: When you spend your Ultimate Charge, cleanse yourself and grant nearby allies 75 Overhealth for 3s.

stadiumItems.name: Skyline Nanites
stadiumItems.description: Ability damage to airborne enemies deal 25% bonus damage over 2s

stadiumItems.name: Vitality Amplifier
stadiumItems.description:
While above 50% Life gain 10% Ability Power.
Otherwise, gain 15% Ability Lifesteal and abilities refresh 10% faster.

stadiumItems.name: Sonic Recharger
stadiumItems.description: Passive Life Regeneration can overheal up to 100.

stadiumItems.name: Catalytic Crystal
stadiumItems.description: Ability Damage and Healing grants 20% more Ultimate Charge.

stadiumItems.name: Superflexor
stadiumItems.description: When you deal Weapon Damage or Healing, gain 5% Ability Power for 3s, stacking up to 5 times.

stadiumItems.name: Three-Tap Tommygun
stadiumItems.description:
After using an ability or Gadget, your next 3 instances of Weapon Damage deals additional damage equal to 3% of the target's current Life over 3s.
(0.5s Cooldown).

stadiumItems.name: Cybervenom
stadiumItems.description: Dealing Ability damage applies 35% healing reduction for 2s.

stadiumItems.name: Liquid Nitrogen
stadiumItems.description: Dealing Ability Damage slows the target's Move Speed by 10% and their bonus Move Speed by 15% for 3s.

stadiumItems.name: Lumérico Fusion Drive
stadiumItems.description: When you use an ability or Gadget, restore 50 Armor or Shields over 3s.

stadiumItems.name: Mark of the Kitsune
stadiumItems.description: When you use an ability or Gadget, your next instance of Weapon Damage or Healing deals {{Ability_Power|25}} bonus damage or healing.

stadiumItems.name: Iridescent Iris
stadiumItems.description: After spending your Ultimate Charge, gain 100 Overhealth for 3s.

stadiumItems.name: Electrolytes
stadiumItems.description: At the start of the round and every time you respawn, gain 30% Move Speed for 10s while out of combat and 100 Overhealth.

stadiumItems.name: Field Rations
stadiumItems.description: While on the Objective, restore 8 Life every 1s.

stadiumItems.name: Adrenaline Shot
stadiumItems.description: Health Packs grant 20% Move Speed for 5s and 50 Overhealth.

stadiumItems.name: Exo Springs
stadiumItems.description:
Holding [Crouch] for up to 0.75 seconds increases the height of your next jump by up to 250%.
(15s cooldown)

stadiumItems.name: First Aid Kit
stadiumItems.description: Reduce the time before your Life begins regenerating by 33%.

stadiumItems.name: Reflex Coating
stadiumItems.description: When you are stunned, slept, hindered or anti-healed, gain 50 Overhealth for 2s.

stadiumItems.name: Siphon Gloves
stadiumItems.description: [Quick Melee] damage heals for 25 Life.

stadiumItems.name: Ballistic Buffer
stadiumItems.description: After taking damage from an Airborne target above 5m, gain 75 overhealth for 3s (8s cooldown)

stadiumItems.name: Cushioned Padding
stadiumItems.description: When affected by Stun, Sleep, or Hinder, restore 10% of your max Life over 3s.

stadiumItems.name: Vishkar Condensor
stadiumItems.description: Convert 150 Health into Shields.

stadiumItems.name: Bloodbound
stadiumItems.description: The last enemy to deal a final blow to you is Revealed to you when nearby. Deal 15% more damage to them and take 15% reduced damage from them.

stadiumItems.name: Ironclad Exhaust Ports
stadiumItems.description: When you use an ability or Gadget, gain 25 Overhealth for 3s.

stadiumItems.name: Repulsion Greaves
stadiumItems.description: After taking damage from an enemy within 5m, knockback all enemies within 6m and gain 75 Overhealth for 3s. (15s Cooldown).

stadiumItems.name: Vital-E-Tee
stadiumItems.description: Convert 100 Health into Armor.

stadiumItems.name: Divine Intervention
stadiumItems.description: When you are Stunned or take more than 125 pre-mitigation damage at once, gain Overhealth equal to 25% of damage taken for 3s and start regenerating your Shields.

stadiumItems.name: Sundering Vial
stadiumItems.description: Damage reduces the enemy's existing Overhealth by 35% and applies 35% Overhealth reduction for 5s. (3s Cooldown).

stadiumItems.name: Overdrive Core
stadiumItems.description: Once per life, if you take damage that would reduce you below 30% Max Life, first gain 150 decaying Overhealth.

stadiumItems.name: Reinforced Titanium
stadiumItems.description: While you have Shields, gain 5% Ability Damage Reduction. Reduce the time before your Shields begins regenerating by 33%.

stadiumItems.name: Gloomgauntlet
stadiumItems.description: [Melee] damage grants 10% Move Speed and restores 5% of Max Life over 2s.

stadiumItems.name: Martian Mender
stadiumItems.description: Restore 3% of your Life every 1s.

stadiumItems.name: Phantasmic Flux
stadiumItems.description: While at full Life, Lifesteal grants up to 50 Overhealth.

stadiumItems.name: Rüstung von Wilhelm
stadiumItems.description: While below 30% Life, gain 10% Damage Reduction.

stadiumItems.name: Ogundimu Reduction Field
stadiumItems.description: When you take damage, gain 0.5% damage reduction for 1s, stacking up to 20 times.

stadiumItems.name: Crusader Hydraulics
stadiumItems.description: When an enemy deals Weapon Damage to your Armor, reduce their Attack Speed by 10% for 3s.

stadiumItems.name: Nebula Conduit
stadiumItems.description: Prevent 15% of incoming damage and instead take that prevented damage over 3s.

stadiumItems.name: Vanadium Injection
stadiumItems.description:
While at 100% Ultimate Charge, gain:
:{{Life}} 50 Health
:{{Weapon_Power}} 10% Weapon Power
:{{Ability_Power}} 10% Ability Power
:{{Attack_Speed}} 10% Attack Speed
:{{Cooldown_Reduction}} 10% Cooldown Reduction
:{{Move_Speed}} 10% Move Speed

stadiumItems.name: Aura Repellant
stadiumItems.description: On Use: Knockback all enemies within 8m.

stadiumItems.name: Barrier Snippet
stadiumItems.description: On Use: Gain 50 Overhealth for 3s.

stadiumItems.name: Feathered Soles
stadiumItems.description: On Use: Gain 25% Move Speed for 5s. Dealing damage removes this bonus.

stadiumItems.name: Med Kit
stadiumItems.description: On Use: Restore 20 Life every 1s for 10s. Taking damage removes this bonus.

stadiumItems.name: Dashing Skates
stadiumItems.description: On Use: Dash a short distance.

stadiumItems.name: Field Support
stadiumItems.description: On Use: Place a Biotic Field at your location that restores 40 Life every 1s for 5s.

stadiumItems.name: Siphon Snippet
stadiumItems.description: On Use: Knockback and apply 35% Healing Reduction for 5s to all enemies within 8m. Gain 25 Overhealth for each enemy hit.

stadiumItems.name: Necrotic Repellant
stadiumItems.description: On Use: Knockback, Hinder and slow all enemies within 8m for 1s.

stadiumItems.name: Vortex Vial
stadiumItems.description: On Use: Place a slowing Vortex that pulls enemies downward at your location for 2.5s.

stadiumItems.name: Kitsune Charm
stadiumItems.description: On Use: Cleanse yourself of most negative effects, restore 75 Life, and gain Invulnerability and 75% Move Speed for 0.65s.

stadiumItems.name: Colossus Core
stadiumItems.description: On Use: Gain Unstoppable, 10% Damage Reduction, 25% Max Life, and grow in size, but deal 25% reduced damage and healing for 3s.

stadiumItems.name: Jet Skates
stadiumItems.description: On Use: Dash a short distance.

stadiumItems.name: Super Serum
stadiumItems.description: On Use: Increase your total Attack Speed by 50% but deal 15% reduced Weapon Damage and Healing for 5s. Reload all your Ammo.

stadiumItems.name: Refresher
stadiumItems.description: Reduce all Ability cooldowns by 8s.

stadiumItems.name: Heartbeat Sensor
stadiumItems.description: Enemies below 30% Life are Revealed to you.

stadiumItems.name: Running Shoes
stadiumItems.description: At the start of the round and when you respawn while not in Overtime, gain 30% Move Speed for 10s while out of combat.

stadiumItems.name: Geneticist's Vial
stadiumItems.description: The first time you would die each round, revive instead with 250 Life after 3s.

stadiumItems.name: Biotech Maximizer
stadiumItems.description: When you use an ability that heals, reduce its cooldown by 5% for each unique ally it heals.

stadiumItems.name: Kitsune Snippet
stadiumItems.description: On Use: Gain 50 Overhealth and 25% Move Speed for 3s. If you are debuffed, gain an additional 100 Overhealth.
